{"metadata":{"description":"断线无限重新连接，适用于不稳定的API或者中转站","id":"gh:1337937308","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-reconnect","slug":"MistRain-1/dsh-reconnect","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"断线无限重新连接，适用于不稳定的API或者中转站"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-reconnect"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> Safe model-request retry for DeepSeek Harness with exponential backoff, relay/proxy failure recove"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ry, and a unified settings panel."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Version:** `2.0.0`"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- 中文文档 (Chinese README)"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Project Description"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"`dsh-reconnect` is a Host-side plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It retries failed model requests s"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"o temporary network failures do not interrupt an agent turn or a long-running task."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The plugin listens to the DSH `agent/request-error` waterfall event. After the built-in `normal` Pro"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"vider retry policy gives up, or when a Provider's `always` policy delegates recovery downstream, the"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" Agent loop sends the same request again according to this plugin's policy."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Suitable Use Cases"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- Unstable relay stations, reverse proxies, API gateways, or forwarding services
- Relay nodes that "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"disconnect, reset connections, or return incomplete responses
- Intermittent network failures and tr"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ansport errors
- Temporary provider outages, server-side 5xx errors, rate limits, and timeouts
- Lon"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"g-running tasks that should survive short-lived provider or network failures"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Retry Policy"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Condition | Behavior |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| `EMPTY_RESPONSE` / `RATE_LIMIT` / `SERVER` / `STREAM_CLOSED` / `TIMEOUT` / `TRANSPORT` | Retry ind"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"efinitely (transient connection/service failures) |
| Model missing or not configured (`MODEL_NOT_FO"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"UND`, `MODEL_NOT_CONFIGURED`, or matching Provider text) | Retry indefinitely while waiting for mode"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"l/account configuration to recover |
| `QUOTA` (insufficient balance or exhausted quota) | Do not re"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"try by default; retried when `retryQuota: true` |
| Unknown errors such as `PI_AI_ERROR` | Retry ind"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"efinitely by default; disable `retryUnknown` to apply the configurable consecutive-failure cap |
| T"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"ool/argument/unknown-tool/auth/credential/context-overflow/aborted | Never retried; step ends immedi"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"ument/unknown-tool/auth/credential/context-overflow/aborted | Never retried; step ends immediately |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Key design points:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- Only retries failures that "resending the same request" can fix — dropped connections, rate limits"},{"id":"p15s2","text":", timeouts, 5xx.
- Tool execution errors (`tool/result`) are outside this plugin's retry boundary. E"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"rror routing uses the machine code from `agent/request-error`, rather than guessing from message tex"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"t; an unknown machine code uses the configured unknown-error path (bounded only when `retryUnknown` "},{"id":"p15s5","text":"is disabled).
- Permanent errors (credentials, request content, context overflow) stop immediately; "},{"id":"p15s6","text":"missing or unconfigured models are the deliberate exception and keep retrying while configuration re"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"covers.
- `retryQuota` and `retryUnknown` control this plugin's fallback chain. The Host `always` po"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"licy delegates recovery to downstream waterfall listeners, so this plugin handles the recoverable fa"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"ilure categories once and does not create a second parallel retry loop."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Backoff and Cancellation"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- Exponential backoff: `1s -> 2s -> 4s -> ...`, capped at `60s` by default (the settings panel offer"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"s 1/2/5/10/30/60/120 seconds or a custom value; `maxDelayMs` overrides in milliseconds)
- Honors a p"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ositive `providerRetryAfterMs` when available. It is a provider minimum wait and is not capped by th"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"e local exponential-backoff limit; only the Node timer maximum applies.
- Logs the provider, error c"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ode, turn, step, retry count, and delay
- Emits standard `llm/retry` events so the Harness conversat"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"ion UI shows the continuous retry count and countdown
- Stops when the current turn is aborted, the "},{"id":"p17s7","text":"plugin is stopped, or the plugin is hot-reloaded; active waits are drained during cleanup."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Visual Configuration"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Open Settings → Plugin configuration. ReConnect is shown as a plugin card in that page:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **Max wait per attempt**: drop-down presets (1/2/5/10/30/60/120 seconds) or a custom value
- **Ret"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ry on quota**: toggle, off by default
- **Retry unknown errors indefinitely**: toggle, on by default"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"
- **Max retries for unknown errors**: default 3. Missing or unconfigured model errors are not subje"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ct to this cap and always retry."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Changes take effect immediately without restarting DSH."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## YAML Configuration"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The plugin accepts optional values in its Cordis row config:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- `maxDelayMs` (integer milliseconds, default `60000`): caps the local exponential-backoff delay; fo"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"r example `15000` produces `1s -> 2s -> 4s -> 8s -> 15s -> 15s...` indefinitely. A positive Provider"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" `Retry-After` remains authoritative.
- `retryQuota` (boolean, default `false`): whether `QUOTA` err"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ors are also retried.
- `retryUnknown` (boolean, default `true`): whether unknown errors are retried"},{"id":"p24s5","text":" indefinitely.
- `unknownMaxRetries` (integer, default `3`): bounded cap for consecutive unknown fai"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"lures in the same model step; missing or unconfigured model errors do not use this cap."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The settings service persists the plugin card values. **Restore defaults** removes the user override"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"s and immediately returns to the schema/Cordis defaults; a restart is not required."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The plugin's own retry policy is the downstream recovery for both Provider `normal` and `always` pol"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"icies. The two layers do not multiply retries: `normal` schedules only its configured codes before t"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"his plugin, while `always` delegates the decision downstream."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"`maxDelayMs` caps the local exponential wait, **not** a Provider `Retry-After` value and not the tot"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"the local exponential wait, **not** a Provider `Retry-After` value and not the total retry duration."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Invalid or missing `maxDelayMs` values fall back to `60000`."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Download"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The package is platform-independent.
